timeline.title: KURE Fellow
highlights: Built translation-invariant sentence embeddings by canonicalizing parallel sentences into Abstract Meaning Representation graphs and embedding them with a contrastively-trained GNN; framed cross-lingual translation as an approximate symmetry of meaning in the Geometric Deep Learning sense. Parsed a novel dataset of 4M AMR graphs for GNN pretraining.

Designed an LLM/GNN hybrid that injects translation-invariant AMR embeddings into pre-trained LLMs via soft-prompt tokens; exceeded LoRA fine-tuning on WMT24++ by ~3 COMET points on average using ~90% fewer trainable parameters.

timeline.title: Research Intern
highlights: Evaluated 10 steering techniques across 8 target concepts in music-language models, measuring both controllability and changes in representation geometry.
Developed steering techniques combining Direct Preference Optimization with model distillation.
Built a training and evaluation pipeline supporting 100+ steered model variants.

timeline.title: KURE Fellow – ML Foundations Group
highlights: Investigated quality-informed data repetition for LLM pre-training; matched DCLM baseline performance using 1/5 the unique tokens by repeating high-quality subsets.
Filtered 2T+ token datasets to train and evaluate 100M–4B parameter models across data-mixture ablations.

timeline.title: Generative AI Research Fellow
highlights: Implemented a diffusion model mapping IMU sensor sequences to 3D human motion reconstructions.
Presented at the Harvard D³ Institute Generative AI Symposium.

timeline.title: Undergraduate Researcher
highlights: Reconstructed nanometer-resolution neural circuits from a 2-petabyte 3D dataset of human cortical tissue.
Characterized chandelier-cell connectivity patterns in human temporal cortex; results contributed to a Society for Neuroscience 2025 abstract.
